deploy_notes: 1) Scope conflict to confirm: the task text said 'Files you may edit or create: (none)', but the round-I.json packet ws04-s9-compose-expose lists docker-compose.yml under files and the new test script under new_files. I followed the packet, because the task text names the packet record as the instruction. If no edit was intended, revert the compose hunk and delete the new script before committing. 2) Behaviour is identical with the switches off: the parser mp_contracts::loop_fold::switch_from (rust/crates/mp-contracts/src/loop_fold.rs:334-336) accepts only 'true' (case-insensitive, trimmed), so 'false' and 'off' both read as off. The two new keys go through the same parser (chat_turn_registry.rs:219 and idempotency_registry.rs:313). 3) Comment accuracy checked against code: SharedClaimValue holds only request_id, run_id, thread_id and state (idempotency_registry.rs:346-352), and the shared turn record holds run_id and skill ids with a 24 h TTL (chat_turn_registry.rs, TURN_TTL). 4) No existing test, script, or Rust or Go test pins the old :-off default or the block layout. The other mentions are verify-replica-run-control.sh header comments, the docs, and one prose comment at docker-compose.replicas.yml:32; none were edited. 5) The edited lines (301 to 316) sit inside the model-gateway environment: service at line 191, environment at line 208, next service session-core at line 808. 6) Lead only, not run by me because docker is off limits for the coder: cd 'apps/Model Plane' && docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.replicas.yml config --quiet. PyYAML is not installed here, so the YAML was not parsed locally; the structure check above is by line position only. 7) core.filemode is false on this machine, so git will not record the script's exec bit (I set it to match its siblings); the test runs under bash, as the packet specifies. No .env file was opened and no docker command ran.
residual_risks: The lead still has to run `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.replicas.yml config --quiet`. It is the only check that the two new keys reach the replicas through `extends`. Docker is forbidden here, so it was not run.

The contract test greps the raw file without checking which block a line sits in. A commented-out copy of a switch line would count as a second match and fail the test, and a copy moved into the wrong service would still pass. That is acceptable for a pin on default values.

The RUN_CONTROL_BUS and SEND_RECEIPTS comments still say 'Roll back with off plus a restart'. That is correct under the strict parser, but it is out of step with the new literal-false default. This is cosmetic and outside this packet's touch-no-other-line rule.
When the WS04-S9 flip commit lands, it must update the script's expected defaults for the four flipped switches, as the script's header comment says. Otherwise this test goes red.
